en: The postcard shows a arranged collection of old Estonian banknotes and coins on a dark background. The notes display various denominations from small penn (penn) values up to 500 marka. Designs include images of cattle, agricultural scenes, allegorical nude figures flanking a central value panel, and decorative patterns. Most notes bear the words "EESTI VABARIGI KASSATAHET" or "EESTI PANGATAHET" indicating the Republic of Estonia's currency. The overall layout looks like a photographic or printed montage of the different banknotes.
